visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Man with short black hair and glasses stands with his arms crossed on a wooden outdoor plaza. He wears a black T-shirt and grey shorts. A young boy in a grey shirt stands in front of him. A hand enters from the left, pointing towards various directions as the scene shifts to an indoor mall entrance with a 'Mitsui Outlet Park' sign. (2) Indoors, the man points at a digital kiosk displaying a restaurant menu for 'SHANN RICE BAR'. He wears glasses and smiles. The background shows mall interior with posters and signage. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a commercial shopping center. (3) A woman with brown hair and bangs is shown in a close-up shot, talking animatedly. She wears a black T-shirt with a cartoon graphic. She gestures with her right hand near her face. The background is a slightly blurred mall interior. (4) The woman walks through a wide mall corridor, pushing a black stroller containing a baby. She points her finger toward the camera and waves. Retail stores like GUESS and EDWIN are visible in the background with bright storefront lighting. (5) In a toy store, the man and boy look at rows of colorful toy boxes on shelves. The boy points at specific toys. Later, the man squats down to show the boy a boxed robot toy. The environment is densely packed with merchandise and bright shelf lighting. (6) A close-up of a baby sitting in a stroller, wearing a brown outfit and sucking on a purple pacifier. The baby looks around curiously. (7) The woman stands in front of a store named 'ZWILLING', pointing at the sign. She is then seen inside, holding a black frying pan and gesturing toward a display of colorful knife blocks. The store is well-lit with white walls and shelves. (8) At a checkout counter, the woman holds a small package and a wallet while talking to the camera. A clerk in a purple uniform and mask is visible in the background processing an order. The scene focuses on her face and the transaction. (9) The man is in a clothing store, holding up two grey athletic T-shirts on hangers to compare their sizes. He holds them against his chest. The store has rows of hung garments and mirrors. (10) In a fitting room area, the man walks out of a stall wearing a black tank top and flexes his biceps. He then stands next to a large poster of Dwayne Johnson, mimicking the athlete's pose. The lighting is high-contrast. (11) Inside a clean, modern public restroom, the man points toward small, child-sized toilets and a diaper changing station. He gestures toward the amenities. The boy stands beside him. (12) The woman is back in the mall atrium, holding multiple red and white shopping bags. She smiles and jumps excitedly. Brief shots show the boy eating a snack and the woman interacting with the baby. (13) The man and boy stand in front of a red stage curtain. They wave their hands and smile at the camera as if saying goodbye. The boy holds a small toy.

The background music remains consistent in volume and energy. A bright 'ding' sound effect occurs as text variety captions appear on the screen, emphasizing the '回家' and '逛街' options. (3) A female voice enters, speaking with high enthusiasm and a slightly higher pitch. Her speech rate is rapid, conveying excitement about the 'Outlet Sale'. The music maintains its energetic electronic rhythm without any pauses or shifts in mode. (4) While in the toy store, the man and boy engage in a brief dialogue. Their voices are softer but still clear against the music bed. A bouncy cartoon 'boing' sound effect is heard when the baby's foot touches a toy box, synchronized with the movement. (5) The female voice returns for a promotional segment. Her articulation is very clear, like a professional broadcast. She mentions '2折' (80% off) with an emphasized rising intonation. Background mall noise is almost non-existent, replaced by the clean studio-processed audio track. (6) Transitioning to the kitchenware store, a 'shimmer' or 'sparkle' sound effect plays as the woman points to the brand logo. Her tone is melodic and teasing as she jokes about her husband. The music's harmonic tension is low, remaining in a stable major mode. (7) During the checkout scene, the woman's speech density is high as she explains the APP member benefits and price calculations. The music continues as a constant, rhythmic backdrop. A 'cha-ching' cash register sound effect is subtly mixed in. (8) In the clothing store and fitting room, the man's voice is louder and playful. His laughter is heard clearly. A heavy 'thud' or impact SFX accompanies his flexing poses, adding a comedic effect to his muscle display. (9) While showing the family room facilities, the man's voice is informative and calm. The music volume is slightly 'ducked' or lowered to ensure his descriptions of the 'little toilets' are clearly audible. No incidental room noise is heard. (10) The final phase features both adult voices and the boy's voice. The audio energy peaks as they cheer. A final series of rhythmic 'ding' effects and a closing synthesizer swell mark the end of the video as the music fades.
